saints.name: The Nativity of St. John the Baptist
saints.title: Precursor of the Lord
saints.shortBlurb: The forerunner sent to prepare the way of the Lord, whose birth to Zechariah and Elizabeth the Church keeps with joy…
biography: The birth of John, son of the priest Zechariah and Elizabeth in her old age, was foretold by the angel Gabriel; at his naming his father's speech returned, and he prophesied. John grew up in the desert and came preaching a baptism of repentance, pointing to Christ as the Lamb of God, and was beheaded by Herod.
His nativity, set six months before Christmas, is one of the few birthdays the Church celebrates, for he was sanctified in his mother's womb.
saints.knownFor: Preparing the way for Christ as His forerunner.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 24 June
